w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: It's settled. The village is calling it "The Ugly Beast." The Codex keeps it.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (21/14/6), with 5 wave-4 fought, 9 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 4 · Forage 26 → 24 · capped · Craft 12 · Talk 17 · Explore 45 → 24 · capped)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE BELOVED — "Speak for the quiet ones."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Marcus Webb ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
